subject: authorized mission projection rendered with semantic data and lazy ECharts
coverage: the raw projection JSON surface is replaced by semantic status and count fields
chart input requires the exact mission ID, positive versions, bounded text, valid time and finite non-negative integer counts
unsupported projection shapes degrade to an accessible error instead of rendering inferred values
ECharts uses SVG rendering and is limited to Bar, Grid and Tooltip
the chart canvas is hidden from assistive technology while values remain in the semantic table
stream state is announced through a status region
ECharts is lazily loaded outside the Mission first-load bundle
the resize observer is disconnected and the chart instance is disposed on unmount
limits: browser E2E, screen-reader and production performance verification remain open
business charts beyond mission trigger and blocker counts remain open
complete responsibility JSON Forms journeys remain open
production compensation and Settings governance assembly remain host work
production identity adapter installation remains a host requirement
